[P2] Reject settlement before recorded invocation activity

Only an upper bound is checked here. In otherwise valid warm-reuse evidence, setting the victim invocation's `settledAtMs` to zero still passes final validation despite its later invocation interval, late activity, and task exit. The offline CLI therefore accepts quiescence that contradicts its own observations. Require invocation settlement to be at or after its native interval and last owned lifecycle/SDK activity. Add this consistency check to the shared final-validation path; the separate retirement audit is not called by the CLI.
